properties.name: toolkit.core.environment
properties.description: Operational environment. PROD activates the strictest write guardrails.

properties.name: toolkit.core.data-directory
properties.description: Local directory for checkpoints, SQLite journal and reports.

properties.name: toolkit.core.minimum-free-space
properties.description: Free disk that must remain available before operation/report writes.

properties.name: toolkit.core.max-concurrent-operations
properties.description: Maximum concurrent foundation operations.

properties.name: toolkit.core.page-size
properties.description: Foundation synthetic-operation page size; independent from DynamoDB and durable-runtime page sizes.

properties.name: toolkit.core.write-enabled
properties.description: Primary remote-write safety gate. Safe default is false.

properties.name: toolkit.core.local-token
properties.description: Loopback API authentication token. Supply externally; never commit a real value.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.enabled
properties.description: Creates real AWS clients when true. Safe default is false.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.region
properties.description: AWS region used by all centrally managed SDK clients.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.profile
properties.description: Explicit AWS shared-config/profile name used by the SDK credentials provider.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.expected-account
properties.description: Twelve-digit AWS account expected by identity validation.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.max-connections
properties.description: Maximum shared SDK HTTP connections. Increasing this can raise downstream pressure.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.connection-timeout
properties.description: AWS SDK HTTP connection timeout.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.acquisition-timeout
properties.description: Maximum wait to acquire an AWS SDK HTTP connection.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.socket-timeout
properties.description: AWS SDK socket timeout.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.max-idle
properties.description: Maximum idle time for pooled AWS SDK HTTP connections.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.api-call-attempt-timeout
properties.description: Maximum duration of one AWS SDK attempt.

properties.name: toolkit.aws.api-call-timeout
properties.description: Maximum total duration of an AWS SDK call.

properties.name: toolkit.dynamodb.page-size
properties.description: Default maximum item count requested by typed DynamoDB access.

properties.name: toolkit.dynamodb.tables
properties.description: Logical-to-physical DynamoDB table mapping. Physical table names remain external configuration.

properties.name: toolkit.http.payment-endpoint
properties.description: Payment/reference HTTP endpoint used by the sample complex workflow.

properties.name: toolkit.http.payment-hosts
properties.description: Allowlisted downstream host names for the payment/reference HTTP integration.

properties.name: toolkit.http.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connection timeout for downstream HTTP calls.

properties.name: toolkit.http.response-timeout
properties.description: Per-request downstream HTTP response timeout.

properties.name: toolkit.http.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum total attempts for retry-safe downstream HTTP reads.

properties.name: toolkit.http.max-response-body
properties.description: Maximum downstream HTTP response body buffered in memory.

properties.name: toolkit.http.max-retry-after
properties.description: Largest Retry-After delay accepted before the operation pauses instead.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.enabled
properties.description: Enables the durable operational runtime.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.healthy-responses-before-increase
properties.description: Healthy response streak required before AIMD increases rate and concurrency.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.circuit-failures-before-open
properties.description: Consecutive adaptive failures required before dispatch pauses through the local circuit gate.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.circuit-open-duration
properties.description: How long the local adaptive circuit remains open before dispatch may resume.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.retry-base-backoff
properties.description: Base full-jitter retry backoff used by toolkit-managed safe retries.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.read-max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum attempts owned by the runtime for retry-safe AWS reads; SDK-level retries remain disabled to avoid stacking.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.writes
properties.description: Second write gate. Effects remain blocked unless every execution guardrail also passes.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.lab-endpoint
properties.description: Local emulation endpoint used only by the Docker/Moto laboratory.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.resources
properties.description: Explicit runtime resource allowlist.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.principals
properties.description: Explicit runtime AWS principal/role allowlist.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.requests-per-second
properties.description: Configured aggregate request-rate ceiling before adaptive reduction.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.workers
properties.description: Configured maximum effective concurrent workers before adaptive reduction.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.page-size
properties.description: Maximum durable planning/execution task page size.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.plan-lifetime
properties.description: Maximum age of a sealed execution plan before re-planning is required.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.approval-lifetime
properties.description: Lifetime of an approval bound to a sealed plan hash.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.retention
properties.description: Retention window for terminal local runtime evidence.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.dry-run-sample-size
properties.description: Maximum number of sanitized before/after samples included in a dry-run summary.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: Graceful wait for the runtime executor before forced local shutdown.

properties.name: toolkit.operations.estimated-bytes-per-record
properties.description: Conservative local ledger/disk estimate per planned candidate used by preflight.

properties.name: toolkit.report.csv-delimiter
properties.description: Single-character delimiter used by reusable CSV writers.

properties.name: toolkit.report.flush-every-records
properties.description: Streaming CSV flush cadence in records.

properties.name: toolkit.report.max-concurrent-reports
properties.description: Maximum simultaneous heavy report projections.

properties.name: toolkit.report.xlsx-row-window
properties.description: SXSSF in-memory row window.

properties.name: toolkit.report.xlsx-max-data-rows
properties.description: Maximum data rows written to one XLSX worksheet; must not exceed the Excel format limit.

properties.name: toolkit.report.xlsx-estimated-bytes-per-row
properties.description: Conservative disk-space estimate per XLSX row used by preflight.

properties.name: toolkit.report.protect-spreadsheet-formulas
properties.description: Prefixes formula-like CSV cells to mitigate spreadsheet formula injection.

properties.name: toolkit.sqs.visibility-timeout
properties.description: Visibility lease used by explicit SQS receive workflows.
